patterns_noted: JULY 3 AFTERNOON FINAL LESSON: (1) NaN PRICE DATA FOR AN ENTIRE SESSION IS AN OPERATIONAL BLIND-SPOT — when current prices are unavailable for a full trading day, the only defensible actions are: hold existing positions, do not open new ones, and set mandatory confirmation triggers for the next live-data session. Always ask: is this a new development or a confirmation of something the market has known for weeks? (4) HOLIDAY HALF-SESSION + NaN DATA = HARD NO on new positions, even in a constructive macro regime. The rule held correctly this cycle. (5) GENERIC SECTOR SUMMARY ARTICLES (Benzinga 'Leading and Lagging Sectors') have zero informational content about a specific sector's relative performance — do not cite them as 'editorial recognition' without the actual sector performance data to back it up.
